nodes.label: ADR-010: one package, zero runtime dependencies
nodes.rationale: npx agent-hub installs in seconds; nothing to audit at runtime; no native modules on Windows. Rejected Hono (saves ~100 lines, adds dependency) and better-sqlite3 (native build). Replaces PLAN's pnpm monorepo with Hono and React; splitting later is a mechanical move.

nodes.label: ADR-011: JSON file formats instead of YAML

nodes.label: ADR-012: panel is plain ES modules, no React, no bundler
nodes.rationale: Zero build step and dependencies (ADR-010); strict CSP with no inline script; easy for agents to read; no innerHTML with data (checked by hub security). React/Vite can replace web/ later without touching the API.

nodes.label: ADR-013: TypeScript via Node type stripping, tsc build for publishing
nodes.rationale: Development runs .ts directly on Node 24 with erasableSyntaxOnly; tsc emits dist/ for publishing because Node refuses to strip types inside node_modules; bin/hub.js picks dist/ when present. Node 22.13+ for node:sqlite to be verified.

nodes.label: ADR-014: hub commits only on hub/* branches
nodes.rationale: A handoff checkpoint needs unfinished work saved, but a run in the user's own working tree must not get a commit made on their behalf. writeCard commits (hooks not skipped) only on hub/<task>/<agent> branches; elsewhere records changed files and checkpoint_committed false; .hub/ excluded. Tested in run.test.ts.
nodes.norm_label: adr-014: hub commits only on hub/* branches
nodes.community_name: Agent Hub (local-first hub for coding agents)

nodes.label: ADR-015: prompt goes through stdin, never arguments
nodes.rationale: Windows command lines are limited to ~32k characters and handoff prompts exceed that; arguments invite quoting and injection bugs. Agents start without a shell using argument arrays; claude -p and codex exec - read stdin; 50 000-char prompt verified intact; Codex needs stdin closed or it waits.
